Message:
selinux: Assign proper class to PF_UNIX/SOCK_RAW sockets

For PF_UNIX, SOCK_RAW is synonymous with SOCK_DGRAM (cf.
net/unix/af_unix.c). This is a tad obscure, but libpcap uses it.
